fittingChanges: Portrait reorders existing masthead controls into a single readable vertical continuum.
Phone landscape keeps poster/title/facts with right-side controls and scrollable remainder.
Viewport-aware cover sizing and horizontal carousel centring preserve the approved flow rather than flattening cards.
Wrapped chapter labels and a compact actions layout keep all chapter controls reachable.
Language and page dropdowns remain floating and bounded; they reposition when the content scrolls instead of closing from a delayed scroll-to-anchor event.
At 354px width with 1.3× text, the same chrome wordmark moves below Back in a taller toolbar to prevent collision.
1280×700 desktop explicitly uses desktop header columns; 1280×800 and 800×1280 remain tablet.
Insets/font-scale/viewport controls are outside the app; no simulated operating-system chrome.
unresolved: Exact OnePlus logical dimensions, device pixel ratio, safe areas and runtime font scaling are unknown because the device is disconnected; all requested presets are provisional.
Frozen assets lack exact per-volume One Piece manga cover files and matching chapter thumbnails; the mock explicitly substitutes named existing One Piece project artwork only.

The frozen default MangaSeries and optional rebuilt TankobanSeriesView differ in masthead/chrome; the requested visible label/progress and the approved component treatments were reconciled for review, not asserted as a byte-for-byte runtime screenshot.
Account/provider actions are intentionally stubbed; local mode HTML navigation does not preserve transient state across pages.
No QML compilation, actual Colosseum runtime, physical phone, APK or production integration was tested. Publication is HELD.
